items.title: Surgeon having lunch near Krakow shooting undoubtedly saved officer's life, colleague says
items.summary: Further details have emerged about two police officers hailed for preventing a Polish gunman from killing more.

items.title: King leads solemn Remembrance Sunday service at Cenotaph
items.summary: Wreaths are laid as 10,000 armed forces veterans, including 12 from World War Two, pay tribute in central London.

items.title: Seven dead and more than 100 injured after trains collide in Egypt
items.summary: Several carriages derailed after two trains travelling in the same direction crashed outside the city of Giza.

items.title: Footage shows derailed carriages after fatal train crash in Egypt
items.summary: It is yet unclear what caused the accident but Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi said an investigation is underway and will "hold accountable anyone who proves their negligence".

items.title: Nandy defends linking Erasmus student scheme to Remembrance Sunday after backlash
items.summary: The culture secretary says the UK rejoining the EU's study and work scheme will help honour wartime sacrifice.

items.title: 'Time is up': Minister warns media industry to take abuse seriously in wake of Brand case
items.summary: Lisa Nandy tells the BBC "many people" in the media industry have come forward to her.

items.title: Iran executes three men for 'armed unrest' after January protests
items.summary: It is claimed Hassan Dioband, Hamid Kazemi and Reza Zanganeh were part of anti-government protests earlier this year.

items.title: Government looking at banning under-16s from Vinted and eBay
items.summary: The culture secretary confirms reports they could be in the list of platforms set to be banned next March.
